passives.name: Terminal: Protect Weakness
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If a Spare Core is present, does not take Weakness Gauge damage. Grants a Barrier for [Buff_T_guild_raid_02_passive_1_4] turn(s) when attacking an enemy inflicted with Burned. Reduces damage dealt to Water enemies and increases damage taken from them, and increases damage dealt to Earth enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Increases damage taken from Dual Attacks and Skill Chains.

buffs.summary: −50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
+30% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
